cd /Users/dct/code/EllyaOrg/projects/dalimaray/observatory-wt/current; markdownlint-cli2 "reports/staging/*.md" >/tmp/walk-md2.txt 2>&1; echo md=$?
cat > /tmp/m4.txt <<'E'
docs(staging): m4-forge-checks-live-walk rows [skip ci]

The live walk was not run: Droid-Shield blocks the push because the
range holds commits 3eeacc7, 12d2c63 and 22cdb27 with token-shaped
literals. The row records the block and the ways to clear it.
E
git add reports/staging/m4-forge-checks-live-walk.md
git interpret-trailers --in-place --if-exists addIfDifferent --trailer "$(cat .git-trailers)" /tmp/m4.txt
git commit -F /tmp/m4.txt >/tmp/c4.out 2>&1; echo c4=$?; tail -2 /tmp/c4.out; git log -1 --format='%h %s'; git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key=Co-authored-by)'; git status --short
